target.description: Resolve the ancient Dialogue between a Man and His Ba only to a provisional Work boundary while separating pBerlin P 3024, P. Amherst III, Mallorca I/II, present museum mountings, historical facsimiles, scholarly joins, editions, transcriptions, translations, repository permissions, and exact Files.
required_properties: reported fragment joins retained as unreviewed reconstruction
ba and soul kept as non-equivalent title variants
no accepted source-text, semantic, graph, canon, or publication effect
acceptable_substitutions: an exact openly licensed historical facsimile of pBerlin P 3024
an originating museum or holding record
an exact openly licensed article documenting Mallorca fragments
a rights-insufficient receipt preserving all exact URLs and identifiers
